article_notes: 11 dogs with cerebral B. gibsoni babesiosis (smear plus PCR) followed after treatment at days 0, 3, 7, 14 and 28; 9 of 11 died. Haematology and biochemistry are compared only with healthy dogs and described over time in the shrinking group of survivors; no marker is compared between dogs that died and dogs that survived, and cerebral cases are not compared with the other 125 babesiosis dogs. Nothing against severity to extract.
